decision_rationale: The paper describes a pretrained multi-omic foundation model, but the model itself is a dense, non-causal encoder trained with MLM, not a genuinely generative architecture. It still shows foundation-model evidence via large-scale pretraining on 250 billion tokens and broad downstream transfer.
evidence_snippet: “dense, non-causal encoder transformer models ... using the masked-language-modeling (MLM) objective” and “pretrained on 250 billion tokens”
